title: Nitrogen sources for neotropical nasute termites: Fixation and selective foraging.
abstract: Studies with Nasutitermes and Rhynchotermes (Isoptera, Nasutitermitinae) in a Costa Rican rainforest suggest that nitrogen fixation by gut symbionts may play a significant role in termite nutrition.
